context:
Goal: a round-3 FAIL holds the change until its finding is fixed (your 356 a).
Problem (rule): on the branch, a held change stays held even after a fix check passes, and its finding goes to a new lane. The lane builds b meanwhile, and a change is a small toggle.
Based on (ruling): item 356 a, 2026-11-07 13:41 CST. Its label says "holds the change until the finding is fixed". Its gain line, which I wrote, said "the finding becomes a new lane at round 1". Option a follows the gain line and b follows the label, so you are asked which you meant.
Departs from: main, where a fix check PASS after round 3 reads done. b keeps that for a held change, and a sends the finding to a new lane.

options.gain: Every round-3 fix gets a full review.
options.label: Stay held; the finding becomes a new lane at round 1
options.lose: A one-line fix waits for a whole lane.

options.gain: Matches "until the finding is fixed", and small fixes ship.
options.label: A fix check that passes clears the hold (recommended)
options.lose: A fix check is lighter than a full round.

reply: b, 14:41 CST: a passing fix check clears the hold. Relayed to lane review-fix-check-round (PR #1440); this closes on its done report.
